topic: K-Stick and the Self-Checkout That Scans Him
hook_text: Unexpected item in the bagging area!
background: Simple grocery store checkout with a self-checkout kiosk and one shopping bag
main_expression: Confident smile turning into wide-eyed confusion
main_pose: Standing proudly beside the scanner while holding one small grocery item
prop: Self-checkout scanner, shopping bag, and one apple
scene_1: K-Stick confidently scans an apple and gives a thumbs-up as the kiosk beeps.
scene_2: The kiosk flashes: "Unexpected item in bagging area!" K-Stick checks the bag, but it is empty.
scene_3: K-Stick slowly steps away, and the kiosk suddenly says: "Please place K-Stick in the bagging area."
twist_ending: K-Stick gasps, then places only his red cap in the bag; the kiosk proudly says: "Thank you for your purchase!"
facebook_caption: K-Stick went shopping for an apple and somehow became the unexpected item! 😂
youtube_description: K-Stick tries a simple self-checkout, but the machine has a very unusual idea of what belongs in the bagging area. A quick, family-friendly stickman comedy reel.
image_prompt: A clean 2D family-friendly cartoon frame featuring K-Stick, a simple black stickman with a round white face, huge expressive eyes, and a signature red cap, standing at a basic grocery store self-checkout kiosk. He holds one red apple beside an empty shopping bag. Minimal reusable background, bold simple outlines, bright colors, comedic confused expression, no brand logos, vertical 9:16 composition.
motion_prompt: 15-second fast-paced 2D stickman animation in three beats: K-Stick scans an apple and confidently gives a thumbs-up; the kiosk flashes a warning and K-Stick nervously checks the empty bag; he steps away as the kiosk identifies him as the unexpected item. He reacts with wide eyes, places only his red cap into the bag, and the kiosk gives a happy confirmation beep. Use simple poses, quick zooms, readable text, squash-and-stretch reactions, and a cheerful comedic sound effect.
